font.title: Persian typography
font.hint: Choose the typeface that feels best to read. Your choice applies immediately and is saved to your account. All fonts are available locally.

home.welcomeHint: A clear view of progress, and everything that needs your attention today.
home.classesHint: Teacher, group or student, and session date. Clock times are not scheduled.
home.gradingHint: Active sessions through today, oldest first. Partial means some selected cells still need an answer; a value or comment counts.
home.empty: Nothing to show here. You're up to date.
home.noFiscalPeriod: No fiscal period covers today. Open Accounting periods to set one up.
home.cafeHint: Sales and gross profit are for today. Debt is the current signed balance of overdrawn accounts.

evaluate.hint: Choose a class and session, select the applicable cells, then enter quality and quantity.
evaluate.visibilityHint: Hide columns to focus. Hidden scores and unsaved changes are kept and included when you save.

setup.title: Getting started
setup.subtitle: A step-by-step guide to your first grading session
setup.studentsHint: Create the student records you want to track.
setup.membersHint: Add students as group members. Both group classes and individual assignments use these memberships.
setup.teachersHint: Each scheduled assignment has a teacher.
setup.parametersHint: Define what you evaluate and its quantity range. Quality always uses 0–100.
setup.intervalsHint: For example, weekly or fortnightly sessions.
setup.assignmentsHint: Connect a teacher, a group or member, an interval, and a starting date.
setup.sessionsHint: Preview and generate session dates. Then choose a session on the Evaluate page.
